judged_text: The raw_html early return also skips Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook), silently suspending the system-wide contract that every post's cooked output passes the plugin pipeline. Sites running plugins that transform cooked HTML via after_post_cook see imported/embedded posts render without those transformations — an inconsistent rendering contract changed with no acceptance from the plugin ecosystem it affects.

adjudication.rationale: In app/models/post.rb, Post#cook now returns `raw` immediately when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`, which bypasses both `post_analyzer.cook(*args)` and `Plugin::Filter.apply(:after_post_cook, ...)`. This creates an observable behavioral divergence for `raw_html` posts (e.g., imported via TopicEmbed/PostCreator with `cook_method: :raw_html`) where any plugins relying on `:after_post_cook` will not run for those posts.
